connection.offlineDetail: You are offline. Nothing you enter here will be lost, but it will not reach the clinic record until the connection returns.

device.enrolledBody: Every request this tablet makes is signed with a key that has never left it. Values entered here are attributed to it.
device.forgetHint: Only if an administrator asks. The tablet will need a new code to write anything.
device.notEnrolledBody: This tablet can sign a person in, but it cannot record clinical values until an administrator enrols it. Ask for a code from the device screen of the admin console; it works for fifteen minutes.
device.codeHint: Ten characters, as shown on the administrator's screen. Case and dashes do not matter.
device.refused: The code was not accepted. It may have expired or been used; ask for a new one.
device.offline: The clinic server cannot be reached. Nothing was changed.
device.unexpected: Enrolment did not complete. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the administrator.
device.done: Enrolled. This tablet can now record values.

login.subtitle: DTHC clinic staff only.
login.offlineTitle: The clinic server cannot be reached
login.offlineBody: Check the network connection and try again. Nothing was sent.
login.unexpected: Sign-in did not complete. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the administrator.

placeholder.title: {screen} is not built yet

queue.subtitle: Patients waiting at your station, in the order they will be called.

queue.waitingCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody waiting} one {# patient waiting} other {# patients waiting}}

realtime.liveDetail: This screen is receiving updates as they happen.
realtime.reconnectingDetail: The live connection dropped and is being re-established.
realtime.offlineDetail: This screen is not receiving updates and may be behind. Anything you save is still recorded.

secondFactor.codeHint: The six digits your app shows now.
secondFactor.recoveryHint: One of the codes you saved when you set up the authenticator. It works once.
secondFactor.loginBody: Your password was accepted. Now the code from your authenticator app.

registration.resumeTitle: You have a registration in progress
registration.resumeBody: {name} was partly registered. Carry on, or start again.
registration.birthHint: The year alone is enough if that is all they know.
registration.future: That date has not happened yet.
registration.implausible: That would make them over 130. Check the year.
registration.nationalIDHelp: Hashed and sealed before it is stored.
registration.backgroundNote: For research. Skip anything not asked.
registration.consentNote: A patient cannot be registered without a recorded consent.

role.tapToSwitch: Tap to act as another role you hold
role.chooseTitle: Which role are you working as?
role.noPasswordNeeded: No password needed. The switch is recorded.
role.switchFailed: That role could not be confirmed. Nothing has changed.

anthropometry.blocked: Check the highlighted value before saving.
anthropometry.notThisStation: This station’s capture screen is not built yet.

anthropometry.warnHigh: Above {limit} {unit}, which is unusually high for this measurement.

anthropometry.warnFell: More than {limit} {unit} below the last recorded value.

note.no_reference_for_sex: No published growth reference covers this patient’s recorded sex.
note.too_old_for_a_growth_reference: Growth percentiles apply up to 20 years of age.
note.nothing_measured_yet: No height, weight or BMI has been recorded yet.

vitals.halfABloodPressure: A blood pressure needs both numbers.

vitals.aboveNormal: Above {limit} {unit} — outside the usual range for this patient.
vitals.noPatient: Call a patient from the queue to begin.

alerts.title: Act on this now
alerts.belowLimit: Below {limit}, which is the critical low.
alerts.aboveLimit: Above {limit}, which is the critical high.
alerts.sentDetail: They have been told. Stay with the patient until somebody comes.
alerts.goAndFind: No screen was listening. Go and tell a doctor in person, now — do not wait for the system.
alerts.seenAndGoing: I have read this — going to find a doctor

examination.noPatient: Call a patient from the queue to begin.
examination.notTestedReason: Why the foot could not be tested
examination.scoreOutOfRange: The symptom score runs from 0 to 13.
examination.interrupted: The {feet} foot is only part tested. Go back and finish it — nine sites is not a monofilament test.

prompt.ulcerHistory: This patient has had a foot ulcer or an amputation. Record the ulcer status of both feet today.
prompt.sensationLost: The {side} foot had lost protective sensation when it was last tested. Repeat the monofilament.
prompt.retinopathySevere: The {side} eye was graded severe or proliferative. Look again and grade it today.
prompt.retinopathyDue: This patient's eye screening is due, or has never been done.

terminology.title: Coded diagnosis
terminology.unreachable: The coded catalogue cannot be reached
terminology.freeText: You may still record the diagnosis in your own words; it can be coded later.
terminology.nothingFound: Nothing in the catalogue matches what you typed.
terminology.noFavourites: This clinic has not ranked any diagnoses in this catalogue yet.
terminology.atCap: Showing the first {n}. Type more to narrow the list.

reason.favourite: A diagnosis this clinic makes often
reason.wordStart: A word starts with what you typed
reason.similar: Close to what you typed — check the spelling

history.noPatient: Call a patient from the queue to begin.
history.lifestyleHint: Recorded there and shown here so nobody asks twice. Two answers to one question cannot both be the current one.
history.carriedHint: Ask the patient about each one. Nothing here counts as true today until somebody says so.
history.nothingCarried: Nothing has been recorded for this patient before.
history.allConfirmed: Everything has been confirmed this visit.
history.oneAtATime: One press, one item. There is no button that confirms the list.

why.neverConfirmed: Nobody has confirmed this since it was recorded
why.notThisVisit: Last confirmed at an earlier visit

history.resolveHint: A clinical fact worth keeping. It stays in the record.
history.removeHint: This was never true. Say why — the reason is the point of removing it.
history.removeReason: Why this should not have been recorded
history.uncodedHint: The catalogue has nothing for this. It is kept in words and counted, so the catalogue can be corrected.
history.unknownKind: Recorded under a kind this tablet does not know

field.duration: How long it has been going on

problem.partialCoding: A coding is a system, a version and a code. Choose from the catalogue again, or record this in words.
problem.wrongCatalogue: That code is from another catalogue. This kind is coded in its own.
problem.nothingSaid: Choose a code, or write what the patient said.
problem.needsRelation: A family history is about a relative. Say which one.
problem.noRelation: This is about the patient, not about a relative.
problem.needsDuration: A complaint says how long it has been going on.
problem.notADuration: A duration is a whole number of days.
problem.noSeverity: This kind of history carries no severity.
problem.noOnset: This kind of history carries no start date.
problem.onsetPartial: A start date and how exact it is travel together.
problem.noDose: Only a medicine carries a dose.

trouble.refused: The server would not record this
trouble.unreachable: The clinic server cannot be reached
trouble.failed: The clinic server could not answer

history.troubleHint: Nothing was recorded. What the patient said is still only in this room — try again before they leave.

status.unknown: An answer this tablet does not know

meaning.NONE_RECORDED: The allergy question has not been put to this patient. That is not the same as having none.
meaning.ALLERGIES_RECORDED: One or more allergies are recorded below, worst first.
meaning.NO_KNOWN_ALLERGY: Somebody asked, and the patient knows of no allergies.
meaning.UNABLE_TO_ASSESS: Somebody asked and the answer could not be got. It does not mean there are none.
meaning.unknown: The server gave an answer this tablet is too old to read. Treat the allergy status as unknown.

empty.NONE_RECORDED: Nothing is recorded because nobody has asked. Do not read this as “no allergies”.
empty.ALLERGIES_RECORDED: The status says allergies are on file, but none came back. Do not read this as “no allergies” — ask again.
empty.NO_KNOWN_ALLERGY: Nothing to record: the patient was asked and knows of no allergies.
empty.UNABLE_TO_ASSESS: Nothing is recorded because the answer could not be got, not because there is nothing.
empty.unknown: Nothing came back, and this tablet cannot read the status. Treat it as unknown.

gate.blocked: This patient cannot be sent to the next station until the allergy question is answered.
gate.open: The allergy question has been answered. This patient may be sent on.
gate.hint: The checkpoint is in the clinic’s database, not in this app. Nothing here can go round it.

allergies.withdrawClosesGate: Taking this back closes the checkpoint again unless an allergy is recorded.

answer.title: Answer the allergy question
answer.hint: Three ways to answer it, and there is no fourth. None of them can be skipped.

allergies.inYourName: Whichever you choose is recorded in your name, and a prescriber will rely on it.

assertHint.NO_KNOWN_ALLERGY: Only after asking. This says, in your name, that the patient knows of no allergies.
assertHint.UNABLE_TO_ASSESS: Somebody looked and could not get an answer. It is not a statement that there are no allergies.

allergies.reasonLabel: Why the answer could not be got
allergies.reasonPlaceholder: Patient is drowsy and no attendant present.
allergies.nothingMissing: Everything this allergy needs has been answered.
allergies.uncodedHint: The catalogue will not have everything. What the patient called it is worth far more here than a blank — it is kept, marked uncoded, and shown on every screen.
allergies.withdrawHint: Nothing is deleted. The entry stays with your reason beside it, because the next clinician needs to know somebody once believed it.
allergies.changesHint: Withdrawn entries included. Somebody believed it and somebody else disagreed, and both halves are worth reading.
allergies.noChanges: Nothing has been said about this patient’s allergies yet.

problem.partialCoding: A coding is a system, a version and a code. Choose from the catalogue again, or record this in words.
problem.nothingSaid: Choose the substance from the catalogue, or write what the patient called it.
problem.unknownReaction: That reaction is not one this clinic records. Choose one from the list.
problem.needsCertainty: Say whether this is suspected or confirmed.
problem.needsReason: Say why the answer could not be got. Without it this is a silent gap wearing a label.
problem.reasonRefused: “No known allergies” takes no reason. It is the answer itself.
problem.needsWithdrawalReason: Say why this should not stand. The reason is the point of taking it back.

trouble.refused: The server would not record this
trouble.unreachable: The clinic server cannot be reached
trouble.failed: The clinic server could not answer

allergies.troubleHint: Nothing was recorded, so the checkpoint is still shut and this patient cannot be sent on. Try again — there is no way round it.

counseling.noSession: No checklist has been opened for this visit
counseling.noSessionHint: Which checklist a patient gets is decided by the conditions coded against them, not chosen here. A complaint in the clinic's own words matches no rule, and a family history is somebody else's illness — so if this patient needs counselling, ask the history station to code the condition, or the physician's desk.
counseling.unwalked: Nobody has opened this checklist for this visit, and nothing has been recorded against it.
counseling.calledFor: Called for by {code}, coded against this patient
counseling.frozen: Version {version}, as it stood when this session opened. A checklist republished since then does not change what this patient was asked about.
counseling.progressHint: Items that must be covered. Optional ones are on the list below and are not counted here.
counseling.taps: {n} taps in all: one for each item, one to finish.
counseling.mayNotTick: The role you are wearing reads this checklist without ticking it — a reviewer's or a physician's. Ticking is each counsellor's own record of what they covered, so the counselling room, the nutrition room and the insulin corner each tick their own items. Nothing here is missing; it is simply not yours to write.
counseling.noText: This item has no text in either language. Do not guess what it asks — reload the checklist, and tell the physician's desk if it is still blank.

inLanguage.en: Shown in English: this item carries no Bangla.
inLanguage.bn: Shown in Bangla: this item carries no English.

ticked.bySomebodyElse: Covered at {when} by {role} — not by you

withdrawn.bySomebodyElse: Taken back at {when}, by somebody else

counseling.undoCount: Taken back {n} times on this visit
counseling.noteHint: Optional, and it goes in with the tick. The item is recorded whether or not you write one — and it cannot be added afterwards, because a second tick would record you as the person who covered the item.
counseling.notePlaceholder: Says she injects into the same spot every day.
counseling.untickReasonLabel: Why this tick should not stand
counseling.untickHint: Nothing is deleted. The tick stays, with your reason beside it, because a tick somebody took back is an answer to what was covered rather than the absence of one.
counseling.nothingOutstanding: Everything that must be covered has been.
counseling.finishHint: This records that you are done. It ticks nothing.
counseling.finishOutstandingHint: Finishing with items uncovered is an honest record, not a mistake — the patient left, the interpreter did not come, the insulin corner was closed. It ticks nothing, and what was not covered stays readable.

problem.needsReason: Say why the tick is being taken back.
problem.reasonTooLong: That reason is longer than the record will hold. Shorten it.
problem.noteTooLong: That note is longer than the record will hold. Shorten it.
problem.badItemCode: That is not one item. One tick covers one item.
problem.notOnThisChecklist: That item is not on this checklist. Reload it.
problem.sessionClosed: This session is finished. Nothing more can be recorded on it.

trouble.refused: The server would not accept that
trouble.unreachable: The server could not be reached
trouble.alreadyCovered: Somebody has already covered this item

advice.reload: Read the checklist again. What is on this phone is behind what the clinic's record says.
advice.retry: Nothing was recorded. Try again once the connection is back.
advice.none: Nothing on this screen will fix that, and nothing was recorded.

gate.unknown: This phone could not read the checkpoint. Nothing on this screen says whether this patient may be sent on — and if counselling is not finished, the queue will still refuse them.

headline.blocked: This patient cannot go on yet

meaning.blocked: The queue will not accept this patient at the physician's station until the items named below are covered. Nothing has been lost and nothing has gone wrong — the checkpoint is doing its job, and it lifts by itself once the counselling is done.
meaning.overridden: Somebody who may do it recorded a reason and sent this patient on. That is not the same as the counselling having been done, and what was outstanding at the time is on the record.
meaning.clear: Everything that had to be covered has been. Nothing here holds this patient back from the physician.

remedyHint.resume: Somebody opened this checklist and did not finish it. Going back returns to the same session, and the ticks already on it stay whose they are.
remedyHint.start: Nobody has opened this checklist for this visit. There is nothing to go back to — it has to be started, in the room named above.

gate.noOverrideHere: There is no way past this from here, and there is not meant to be. A physician can record a reason and let this patient through: it is their permission, the reason is required, and every one of them is counted.

lifestyle.noPatient: Call a patient from the queue to begin.
lifestyle.noInstruments: The catalogue came back empty. Reload before asking the patient anything — an empty list is not the same as a clinic with no questionnaires.
lifestyle.ownWritingWhy: Written here, and not a published instrument. An answer to it must never be reported as though it came from a validated scale.

score.title: Lifestyle risk score
score.needMore: Another {n, number} of the four areas has to be assessed. Below {minimum, number} the server computes nothing at all — a lifestyle risk worked out from one or two answers promises far more than it holds.
score.notScoredYet: Enough is on record for a score. The next questionnaire answered here will produce one.
score.domains: From {n, number} of the {outOf, number} areas.
score.domainsUnknown: The record does not say how many areas went into this score. Do not set it beside another one.
score.proposed: Nobody has agreed this arithmetic yet.
score.version: Formula version {version} — the ending is what says a clinician has still to agree what the score weighs.
score.onRecord: This is the score already on the patient's record, not one produced by anything you have just done.
score.notRead: This tablet could not read where the patient stands, so it cannot say which areas are still needed. It will as soon as it can reach the server.

lifestyle.optionalNotAnswered: Not answered, and it may stay that way

numberProblem.below: Below {min, number}, which this question does not take.
numberProblem.above: Above {max, number}, which this question does not take.

lifestyle.outstanding: Still to answer: {n, number}. The questionnaire is saved in one go.
lifestyle.packYearsBy: Worked out by the server from the two counts above, formula version {version}.
lifestyle.warnLow: Below {limit, number} {unit} — ask again before saving.
lifestyle.warnHigh: Above {limit, number} {unit} — ask again before saving.
lifestyle.warnRose: Up by more than {limit, number} {unit} since last time.
lifestyle.warnFell: Down by more than {limit, number} {unit} since last time.

trouble.refused: The server would not accept that.
trouble.unreachable: This tablet could not reach the server. Nothing was recorded.
trouble.failed: Something went wrong that this screen cannot explain.
trouble.notLicensed: This clinic has not licensed that questionnaire. Nothing is wrong with the role you are wearing — the answers cannot be recorded until somebody writes a licence for it on the record.

lifestyle.noWording: This question has no wording in either language. Do not guess at it — read the questionnaires again, and tell the physician's desk if it is still blank.
lifestyle.noTotal: This questionnaire is not scored as a total. The answers are the record.
lifestyle.catalogueMoved: The questionnaires have been republished since this tablet fetched them. Read them again before starting one — the copy in hand may ask something the record no longer accepts.

nutrition.noPatient: Call a patient from the queue to begin.

day.title: The day being recalled

relation.ahead: A day that has not happened yet

day.unusual: A 24-hour recall is about a day that has already finished. Step the day back unless you really meant this one.
day.anyoneMayTakeBack: Either assistant may take back any entry, including one the other recorded. Say why, and both names stay on the record.
day.empty: Nothing has been recorded against this day yet.
day.otherDays: Other days this patient has a recall for
day.mealNotNamed: This tablet could not read the name of this meal. The items are still here, under the code the record uses.

totals.title: The day so far, as the server adds it up
totals.notRead: The day could not be read. Nothing here is a total of anything until it can be.
totals.entries: {n, number} items recorded and still standing.
totals.shared: {n, number} people have recorded food on this day.
totals.sharedWhy: Read the list below before adding anything. The same food entered twice is the one mistake two people working on one recall actually make.
totals.alone: One person has recorded on this day so far.
totals.none: Nobody has recorded anything on this day yet.

table.title: Nobody has approved this food table
table.body: All {n, number} of these foods carry figures from published sources that no one at this clinic has checked or agreed to. It is a starter list you are meant to correct, so read every calorie figure here as a working estimate and say when one is wrong.

form.title: Add what the patient ate
form.placeholder: What the patient said they ate
form.searchHint: Type it the way the patient said it. The search matches the everyday names as well as the formal ones, in either script.
form.searchFailed: The food table could not be searched.
form.noResults: Nothing in the table matches that.
form.askForIt: Ask for the food to be added rather than recording something close to it. A near-enough food becomes a calorie figure nobody can correct later.
form.atCap: The first {n, number} matches. Type more of the name to narrow it.
form.measureHint: Only the measures this food has a weight for are offered. Grams always works.
form.noMeasures: The measures have not been read yet, so there is nothing to record this in. Read the day again before going on.
form.noGrams: Grams is not on offer, which means the measures list did not arrive. Read the day again.
form.portion: One of these weighs {grams, number} g
form.universal: The same for every food — use it when the table has no portion for what the patient described

missing.measure: Choose a measure this food can be weighed in.
missing.quantity: Say how many — more than none.
missing.tooMany: That is more than one entry may carry — at most {max, number}. Record it as two entries if the patient really ate that much.

form.noMeals: The meals have not been read yet, so nothing can be recorded against a time of day. Read the day again before going on.

withdraw.title: Take this entry back
withdraw.why: It stays on the record, struck through, with your name beside the reason. Nothing is deleted.
withdraw.reasonLabel: Why it is being taken back
withdraw.placeholder: Say why in a few words

reason.duplicate: The other assistant had already recorded this.
reason.corrected: The patient corrected what they said.

trouble.refused: The server would not accept that.
trouble.unreachable: This tablet could not reach the server. Nothing was recorded.
trouble.failed: Something went wrong that this screen cannot explain.
trouble.cannotWeigh: The table does not know what that measure of that food weighs.
trouble.alreadyWithdrawn: Somebody has already taken that entry back. The day below will show what they did.
trouble.useGrams: Record it in grams instead — grams works for every food — or ask for the portion to be added to the table.

attribution.revealHint: Shows who entered this value, in which role, at which station and when.
attribution.replacementElsewhere: The value that replaced this one is a separate record; this one does not name who wrote it.
attribution.directoryMissing: This tablet could not read the staff list, so names are missing. Everything else here comes from the value itself.
attribution.notBlame: This says who entered the value. It is not a judgement about anybody's work.

headline.byNobody: This tablet cannot say who entered this · {when}

person.nobody: Nobody is named on this value

standing.deactivated: This person is no longer at the clinic.

deviceStanding.retired: This device is no longer in service.

sourceMeaning.STATION: An operator measured this and typed it at a station.
sourceMeaning.OCR: A machine read this off a photograph of paper. Check it against the paper before acting on it.
sourceMeaning.FIELD: This was recorded away from the clinic, on a field visit.
sourceMeaning.DEVICE: An instrument sent this value; nobody typed it.
sourceMeaning.PATIENT: The patient reported this. It was not measured here.
sourceMeaning.unrecorded: This value does not say where it came from, so it must not be read as a station measurement.

correction.amended: This item was changed after it was first recorded.
correction.withdrawn: This was taken back after it was first recorded.
correction.corrected: This value was found to be wrong and has been replaced.
correction.superseded: This value was right and has since been measured again.

corrections.intro: These are values you entered that a colleague has asked you to look at again. The request comes to you because you took the measurement — nobody else can check it as quickly.
corrections.notBlame: A value questioned and put right is this system working. Nothing on this screen is a mark against anybody's work.
corrections.emptyDetail: When a colleague asks you to look again at a value you entered, it appears here — on this device, because the request goes to whoever took the measurement.
corrections.emptyAnswered: Nothing routed to you has been answered yet.
corrections.hideAnswered: Show only what is still waiting
corrections.notice: {count, plural, one {# value you entered has been questioned} other {# values you entered have been questioned}}
corrections.noticeHint: Opens the values a colleague has asked you to look at again.
corrections.noNote: They wrote no note with it.
corrections.askedWhenUnknown: The record does not say when this was asked.
corrections.valueMissing: This tablet could not read the value that was questioned. Nothing can be answered until it does — try again once the connection is back.
corrections.correctHint: Type it as you read it, in the unit you used. The measurement keeps the time it was taken, and the value that is there now stays on the record — nothing is deleted.
corrections.noteLabel: Anything you want them to know (optional)
corrections.notePlaceholder: The tape had slipped down the wall.
corrections.standsWhy: Say why. A colleague told only “no” cannot tell a disagreement from an oversight, learns nothing either way, and stops asking — and a clinic where nobody questions a number has an audit trail and no quality signal.
corrections.standsReasonPlaceholder: Measured twice on the stadiometer; it is 150 cm.

problem.empty: There is nothing here to record. Type the value as you read it.
problem.notANumber: That is not a number this record can hold.
problem.negative: A measurement cannot be below zero.
problem.unchanged: That is the value already on the record. If it is right, say so and say why instead.
problem.noteTooLong: That note is longer than the record will hold. Shorten it.
problem.needsReason: Say why the value stands. A refusal with no reason tells the person who asked nothing at all.
problem.reasonTooLong: That reason is longer than the record will hold. Shorten it.
problem.cannotAnswerHere: This value cannot be retyped here.

cannot.derived: This value was calculated from other measurements. Correcting one of those is what changes it — put the measurement right and this follows by itself.
cannot.notHere: This is a coded value, chosen from a list rather than typed. It is changed at the station that records it, where the list is.
cannot.unknown: This tablet cannot tell what kind of value this is, so it will not offer to retype it.

outcome.rejected: You recorded that the value stands.

corrections.recomputedNot: {code} could not be calculated again. Somebody has to look at it.
corrections.answeredElsewhere: This was already answered — from another device, or by a supervisor. Nothing was recorded twice and nothing you did was lost.
corrections.notYours: This request was routed to somebody else. Whoever took the measurement answers it; the refusal above names them.
corrections.notThisRole: The role you are wearing cannot read this queue. The requests are yours, not the role's — switch to the role you were working as and they will be here.

trouble.refused: The server would not accept that
trouble.unreachable: The server could not be reached

advice.reload: Read the queue again. What is on this phone is behind what the clinic's record says.
advice.retry: Nothing was recorded. Try again once the connection is back.
advice.none: Nothing on this screen will fix that, and nothing was recorded.

quality.intro: This is your own record, on your own device. Nobody has to give you permission to read it.
quality.windowUnknown: The record does not say which period this covers.
quality.work: values you entered in the last {days, number} days
quality.workNone: Nothing has been entered under your name in this window yet, so there is nothing here to count.
quality.questionsLabel: Values a colleague asked you to look at again
quality.rateKnown: {rate, number} for every hundred values you entered.
quality.nothingQuestioned: Nobody has questioned a value you entered in this window.
quality.defending: Saying a value stands is part of the job. It is counted on its own here and never added into anything else — a colleague who looks again and finds the reading was right has done exactly what they were asked to do. A correction a supervisor made is counted apart too, because it was not your act.
quality.openAction: Open the values waiting for you
quality.openHint: Opens the values a colleague has asked you to look at again.
quality.noteNotApproved: Nobody has approved the numbers behind this note. It is a proposal for a conversation, not a finding.
quality.noteApproved: A clinician has approved the numbers behind this note.
quality.noteUnnamed: A note was written on this record under {code}. This tablet holds no wording for it.
quality.noteActionLabel: What this suggests a supervisor does
quality.patternHour: What time the value was taken
quality.patternHourNote: Out of how many values you entered in that hour. The hour the value was taken, not the hour it was questioned — the shift you are on is not a fact about you.
quality.rulesShow: What puts a note on a record
quality.rulesIntro: The same three for everybody in the clinic. You can read them here before one is ever written about you.
quality.rulesMissing: This tablet could not read the rules. They are the same for everybody; ask a supervisor to show you.
quality.ruleNotApproved: Proposed. No clinician has approved these numbers yet.
quality.notBlame: This record exists so that a pattern nobody has noticed gets noticed, and so that you are the first to see it. It plays no part in pay and no part in any decision about anybody's job.

notice.raised: Something has been written on your own record.
notice.answered: Somebody has answered the note on your own record.

quality.noticeHint: Opens your own record: what you entered, what was questioned, and anything written about it.

trouble.unreachable: This tablet could not reach the server, so your record has not been read.
trouble.refused: The server would not return your record.
trouble.failed: Something went wrong while reading your record.

advice.waitForLink: It will read again by itself when the connection comes back.
advice.tellSomebody: This should not happen — your own record needs no permission. Tell whoever looks after the system.
advice.tryAgain: Leave this screen and come back to read it again.

noteState.acknowledged: A supervisor has read this and is acting on it.
noteState.dismissed: A supervisor has looked at this and decided it is not a problem.

quality.rateSoon: {needed, number} more values in this window and a rate will appear — below {floor, number} it would be worked out from too little to mean anything.
quality.rateNotYet: No rate for this window yet.
quality.noteEvidenceLabel: The corrections it was written on
quality.noteEvidenceAsOf: As it stood on {date}. It may have been answered since.
quality.patternReasonNote: Out of the values a colleague asked you to look at again.
quality.patternCodeNote: Out of how many of that measurement you took.
quality.noteKept: Answered notes stay on your record for {days, number} days.

exercise.noPatient: Call a patient from the queue to begin.

questions.title: What could stop this patient exercising
questions.why: Answer all of these before recording. The server works out which exercises this patient may be offered from these answers, so there is no list until every question has an answer — and a question left blank is recorded as “no”, which is not the same as not having asked.
questions.notRead: The questions have not been read yet. Nothing can be recorded until they arrive.
questions.outstanding: {n, number} still unanswered. Leaving one blank records it as “no”, and not having asked is not the same as “no”.
questions.newlyAdded: New question — added to the list since this tablet last read it

mobility.title: Mobility
mobility.walks: Does the patient walk without help?
mobility.walksHint: Leave this on “not asked” if nobody asked. A patient nobody asked is a different record from one who cannot walk unaided.
mobility.minutesPlaceholder: Leave blank if they cannot say
mobility.minutesHint: Leave it blank rather than guessing. An invented number is worse here than no number at all.

problem.notANumber: Write the minutes as a whole number, or leave it blank.
problem.outOfRange: Between {min, number} and {max, number} minutes a day.

mobility.jointPain: Joint pain, in their own words

findings.title: What was found today
findings.none: None of the conditions asked about applies today.

walks.notAsked: Nobody asked whether they walk unaided.

findings.walkMinutes: Walks about {n, number} minutes a day.
findings.asked: {n, number} questions were put to the patient when this was taken.

exclusion.title: {excluded, number} of {library, number} are not shown
exclusion.why: Those exercises were left out on the server and never reached this tablet, so they cannot be shown here whatever anybody presses. If one of these reasons is wrong for this patient, say so — the reasons are written to be argued with.
exclusion.overlap: One exercise can be left out by two conditions at once, so these figures overlap and do not add up to the total above.
exclusion.notAsked: {n, number} not shown until the question about {condition} has been asked
exclusion.unasked: {n, plural, one {One of these is a question nobody has put to this patient yet — it was added to the list after this assessment was taken.} other {# of these are questions nobody has put to this patient yet — they were added to the list after this assessment was taken.}} Ask the questions again, and the exercises come back if the answers are no.

library.unapproved: Nobody has approved this exercise library
library.unapprovedWhy: All {n, number} of the exercises on offer are a starter list that nobody at this clinic has checked or agreed to. Say when one is wrong, or missing.

offers.title: What this patient may be offered
offers.none: Nothing in the library is safe for this patient’s recorded conditions today, so there is nothing to issue until one of them changes.
offers.incomplete: {n, number} chosen without both numbers. Say how many times a week, and how many minutes each time.

problem.times: Say how many times a week.
problem.timesRange: Between {min, number} and {max, number} times a week.
problem.minutes: Say how many minutes each time.
problem.minutesRange: Between {min, number} and {max, number} minutes each time.

superseded.title: A newer assessment was recorded
superseded.body: Somebody recorded new findings for this patient while you were choosing, so the list has been read again. Look through it before issuing — an exercise that was safe under the old findings may not be on it now.

contraindicated.title: One of those is not allowed any more
contraindicated.body: The server refused a choice as unsafe for this patient’s recorded condition. The list has been read again; choose from what is on it now.

review.dropped: {n, plural, one {One of your choices is not on the new list and has been taken off the plan:} other {# of your choices are not on the new list and have been taken off the plan:}} {names}

moved.title: The library has changed
moved.body: One of your choices is no longer in the library. The list has been read again; choose from what is on it now.

sheet.title: The plan given to the patient
sheet.totalWhy: The total is worked out on the server, so this screen, the printed sheet and the research record cannot disagree about it.
sheet.superseded: A newer plan has replaced this one.
sheet.unapproved: {n, number} of these come from a library nobody at this clinic has approved yet.
sheet.builtFrom: Filtered against the findings taken today. Those findings stay attached to this plan even after they change, so it can still be read as the decision it was.

trouble.refused: The server would not accept that.
trouble.unreachable: This tablet could not reach the server. Nothing was recorded.
trouble.failed: Something went wrong that this screen cannot explain.
trouble.onRow: The server refused one of your choices. The reason is on that exercise below.

advice.ask: Answer the questions below, then record the findings.
advice.reread: The questions have been read again, and anything new is marked. Answer it, then record the findings.
advice.review: The list has been read again. Look through it before issuing the plan.
advice.retry: Nothing was recorded. Try again once this tablet can reach the server.

sync.locked: Sign in to see what this tablet is still holding.
sync.statusSynced: Everything on this tablet is with the clinic.
sync.statusAttention: {count, number} need somebody to look at them
sync.statusHalted: Sending has stopped. Nothing has been lost.
sync.never: Nothing from this tablet has reached the clinic yet.
sync.needsYou: Entries somebody has to look at
sync.clockAhead: This tablet's clock is {minutes, number} minutes ahead of the clinic's.
sync.clockBehind: This tablet's clock is {minutes, number} minutes behind the clinic's.
sync.clockHeld: Until the clock is corrected, the clinic will hold what is recorded here instead of accepting it. Tell the administrator.
sync.haltSessionLost: Sign in again and everything waiting will go by itself.
sync.haltDeviceRefused: The clinic no longer accepts this tablet. {count, number} entries have not reached the record — do not wipe it; take it to the administrator.
sync.haltStorageFull: There is no room left on this tablet. Free some space and try again; nothing has been lost.
sync.reasonDeviceRefused: The clinic is holding this because of the tablet it came from. A physician decides whether it enters the record.
sync.reasonClock: The clinic is holding this because the time it carries cannot be trusted. Somebody has to say what time it was.
sync.reasonUnknownType: The clinic's server does not know this kind of entry yet. It will go once the clinic is updated.
sync.reasonInvalid: The clinic did not accept this entry. It has to be looked at and recorded again.
sync.reasonConflict: This record has changed since it was entered here. Look at it again before sending.
sync.reasonEarlierFailed: An earlier entry for the same record has to be dealt with first.
sync.reasonRefused: The clinic did not accept this entry.
sync.delivering: This tablet is no longer accepted, so it is handing its remaining {count, number} entries to the clinic for review. Do not close the app until this finishes.
sync.haltDeviceMismatch: This tablet's enrolment does not match its key. Nothing has been lost, and nothing more will be sent until an administrator enrols it again.
sync.heldAtClinicNote: Entries held at the clinic are not lost. A physician decides whether each one enters the record.
sync.statusStalled: {count, number} cannot be sent until the clinic reviews what this tablet has already sent.
sync.awaitingTriageLabel: Waiting for room at the clinic
sync.triageFull: The clinic is holding as many entries from this tablet as it will hold, so it cannot take any more. Nothing has been lost and you can carry on recording. A physician at the clinic has to work through what this tablet has already sent; once they have, this tablet will send the rest by itself.
sync.reasonQuarantineFull: The clinic has no room left to hold entries from this tablet. A physician there has to work through the ones it has already sent.
sync.lastChecked: Last checked at {when}: the clinic still had no room.
